svg.title: C# minimal project structure
svg.desc: Directory tree showing a minimal C# project. Program.cs is highlighted in blue as the only file the student touches. All build and IDE artifacts are shown in muted red as bloat to ignore.

g.text: App.assets.cache, App.sourcelink.json, App.AssemblyInfo.cs, App.dll, apphost, ref/App.dll, refint/App.dll …

svg.text: everything in red is auto-generated by .NET for C sharp projects, but thankfully, we have a workaround
